gloss: to wring, to squeeze; to narrow down

definitions.explanation: To twist something to extract liquid.
To reduce options or focus on a specific target.

examples.japanese: {濡|ぬ}れたタオルを{絞|しぼ}る。
{候補|こうほ}を3{人|にん}に{絞|しぼ}った。
examples.english: I narrowed down the candidates to three people.

examples.japanese: {知恵|ちえ}を{絞|しぼ}って{解決策|かいけつさく}を{考|かんが}えた。
examples.english: I racked my brains to think of a solution.

notes:
{絞|しぼ}る means to wring, squeeze, or narrow down.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: Xを{絞|しぼ}る

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- タオルを{絞|しぼ}る (to wring a towel)
- {雑巾|ぞうきん}を{絞|しぼ}る (to wring out a cloth)
- {知恵|ちえ}を{絞|しぼ}る (to rack one's brains)
- {声|こえ}を{絞|しぼ}る (to squeeze out one's voice)
- {的|まと}を{絞|しぼ}る (to narrow the focus)
- {候補|こうほ}を{絞|しぼ}る (to narrow down candidates)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {搾|しぼ}る (to squeeze out juice/milk - different kanji)
- {絞|しぼ}り{込|こ}む (to narrow down further)
